# LUCH · independent creative review

For any website, README, onboarding, visual, demo, listing or public host-integration change, apply the [HEA Creative Gate](https://github.com/lenar2/luch/blob/main/docs/HEA_CREATIVE_GATE.ru.md) ([English](https://github.com/lenar2/luch/blob/main/docs/HEA_CREATIVE_GATE.md)).

- [ ] Technical-only change (explain scope below), or:
- [ ] Public human-experience change — **HOLD** until all gates below are evidenced.

**Human result:**  
**First-time audience:**  
**One primary proof of actual work (or label as designed scenario):**  
**Unprompted first click and actual availability:**  
**Exact SHA and fixed rendered preview:**

- [ ] Independent creative critic, **not an author**, supplied six-axis verdict on exact SHA
- [ ] 5 genuine uncoached first-time viewers; verbatim responses and clicks retained
- [ ] ≥4/5 understand benefit, ≥4/5 find a real first step, ≥4/5 independently want to try
- [ ] Creative scores all ≥3, desire and distinctiveness 4, no fatal misleading claim
- [ ] Actual renders at 320/390/768/1440 plus keyboard, language and proof checks
- [ ] Engineering/rollback QA documented separately
- [ ] Founder approved **this exact SHA**, after objections were resolved

[Independent review form](https://github.com/lenar2/luch/blob/main/docs/HEA_REVIEW_PACKET.ru.md)  
**Verdict / reviewer URL / founder approval:** HOLD / NO_GO / PASS.

**A checklist is not technical branch protection.** No verified GitHub ruleset is active yet; default remains manual HOLD. Do not use GitHub Actions.
